Atrocious user experience can’t transfer memos off of ipad. Short version: You can’t transfer audio files larger than 500kb out of the app unless you buy the pro version. 
 
There are several problems with the UI. If you try to transfer a memo larger than 500kb... you just can’t. Unless you pay for the pro version, seemingly. But given how terrible the free version is, I’m not going to chance it.
If you try to email a memo, you get a message telling you to change your email settings to allow sending a memo larger than 500kb. But there is no such setting. 
When I tried to send via Messages, the UI just completely fails. Adding a new recipient results in a blank row in the UI and it’s not clear how to proceed from there. 
It’s just astonishing that it could be so hard to transfer a file. I literally might have to play the recording from my ipad into the mic of a separate device in order to transfer the file. 
This after a half hour searching the web for solutions I really tried. Totally ridiculous.

Here’s a feature request for the developers, one that I have previously seen in only an old, now discontinued app called Note2Self. With Note2Self running, I can bring the phone to my ear, and the phone will vibrate to indicate that it has started recording. When I’m done speaking and move the phone away, it vibrates again to indicate that it has stopped recording. This feature is invaluable when driving.

Another nice feature to have is automatic sending by email. I know that I can use the share sheet, but that is several taps (tap the “i” icon, tap on Mail icon, enter email address, etc.). A feature that automatically sends an email to a preset address as soon as recording has ended would be great.

I noticed tonight that every recording I've made today recordings which should have been over an hour long were between ten and thirteen seconds long. Thinking there had to be a mistake, I listened to them. All of them had been cut short after less than half a minute.

After some testing, I noticed the following: I'd start recording and lock the phone. On unlocking, AudioMemos would still give the appearance of recording Pause button and volume level indicator are displayed but the recording length number had frozen after a few seconds. This happened numerous times. The period of time at which it stopped recording varied, but it was almost always under twenty seconds.

Yesterday, AudioMemos worked fine. Today, following an automatic update, it doesn't. I lost a lot of things I wanted to record today. This is a serious bug, and, as far as I'm concerned, makes the app unusable. I'll be using another app until this is fixed.
